answer: The engagement provided limited assurance for 1 January through 31 December 2025. Its subject matter comprised selected E&S KPIs in Annex 1 prepared under ArcelorMittal's internal reporting guidance and the Annex 3 EU Taxonomy report prepared under Article 8 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852. Remaining information in the Sustainability Report was outside the engagement and received no conclusion. The work was conducted under ISAE 3000 (Revised), as adopted in Luxembourg.

scope_boundary.excluded: remaining information included in the Report

evidence.quote: limited assurance engagement ... covering the period from January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025
we did not perform assurance procedures on the remaining information included in the Report
